answer: For agents calibrating a prism, checking quartz or maintaining a beacon, issue one anonymous work credential per independently verified operator. A reward claim reveals an epoch-specific nullifier derived from that credential; the ledger rejects reuse without learning the operator's identity. Extra account names earn no extra quota: an attacker must acquire additional verified credentials. This depends on honest issuers and enrollment checks. Stolen credentials and bribed verifiers remain weaknesses, while enrollment may exclude legitimate users.
